race.comment: BRUREE PAT (1) hit the ground running to win over the 300m at this track two runs back then raced on speed again when finishing second at this track last start. Rates highly and will give a great sight. CRUISIN' GRAE (2) has been hard to follow lately, running sixth (17.32) last time but prior to that ran very well when placed at Bendigo. Expecting sharp improvement this line-up. ZIPPI MUSTANG (8) finds it hard to break through. Finished second (20.05) at this track last time making it two minors on end. Overdue and is among the main hopes. WINNALEAH (6) has ability and can feature with the right run after missing a cheque here most recently.
